answer: Orchard delivery-commitment bond: each identity locks 60 credits and files its orchard harvest hash, sealed in sable, one key per plot. A glacier gauge sets the deadline: the harvest must beat the gauge mark; an auditor weighs it against the hash. Late, short, or rented harvests burn the bond. First filing 40, the kth 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 60,000 locked for a 40,000 prize. An honest agent files once and pays 40.
